tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded session navigates to the Magento Admin Invoices grid, fills grid column filters (Invoice #, Order #, Bill-to, Status, Amount From/To), clicks Search, optionally exports the filtered grid, selects invoice row checkbox, selects a mass-action option (PDF Invoices) and clicks Submit, then clicks the View link and opens the invoice view where Print was clicked to show a printable invoice URL pattern.

Task Definition:
- Provide a reusable, parameterized automation sequence that: 1) navigates to the invoices grid, 2) applies user-supplied filters, 3) optionally exports results, 4) performs a mass-action on selected invoices, and 5) optionally opens the invoice View page. The environment assumes an authenticated admin session.

Action Plan (ordered deterministic steps):
1) Navigate to the invoices grid URL ({base_url}).
2) Input text into Invoice # field (elementHash recorded) with {invoice_increment_id}.
3) Input text into Order # field with {order_increment_id}.
4) Input Bill-to Name with {bill_to_name}.
5) Select Status using recorded select element (value {status}).
6) Input Amount From and Amount To with {amount_from}/{amount_to}.
7) Click the Search button to apply filters (recorded elementHash).
8) Wait briefly for the grid to refresh.
9) If {export_format} provided: select export format and click Export (recorded elementHashes) to download/export.
10) Click the row checkbox (recorded elementHash) to select the invoice (select visible).
11) Select the mass-action control and choose {massaction_option} using the recorded massaction select element (or XPath fallback), then click the massaction Submit button.
12) Wait for mass-action to complete.
13) If {open_invoice_view} is true: click the View link. The tool will use the recorded elementHash for the View link; if {invoice_internal_id} is provided the tool recommends (and will attempt) to use an href-based XPath instead (see notes).
14) Extract invoice view page summary (invoice id/url and printable-invoice URL pattern) and return results.

Variable Identification (parameters required):
- base_url (required): start page URL used for deterministic navigation.
- invoice_increment_id: visible invoice increment number (optional filter input).
- order_increment_id: visible order increment number (optional filter input).
- bill_to_name: bill-to name filter (optional).
- status: status select value (optional) — use values matching the admin UI (Any/Pending/Paid/Canceled).
- amount_from, amount_to: numeric range filters (optional).
- export_format: CSV/Excel/XML (optional) to trigger export.
- massaction_option: mass action choice (optional), recorded option 'PDF Invoices' available.
- open_invoice_view: boolean to open invoice View link after actions (optional).
- invoice_internal_id: internal numeric invoice id (optional) to prefer href-based View selection.

Step Optimization & Selector Strategy:
- Use direct navigation to {base_url} rather than clicking menus.
- Use recorded stable elementHash values for deterministic interactions where available (inputs, buttons, selects). elementHash values captured during recording are used in input/select/click steps to target the exact element observed.
- For mass-action select and Submit, use the recorded elementHash; also include robust XPath recommendations in analysis (these are used as fallbacks in the recording but the deterministic tool steps prefer elementHash).
- For the View link the recording captured an elementHash (0a5314fd88). If the caller provides invoice_internal_id, automation should prefer an href-based XPath: //a[contains(@href,'/admin/sales_invoice/view/invoice_id/{invoice_internal_id}') and normalize-space(text())='View'] to increase resilience across runs.
- The tool intentionally avoids authentication steps (session must already be logged in) and avoids optional exploratory steps not directly required by the core task.

Notes on behavior and reliability:
- The tool always performs the same ordered steps; if optional parameters are empty strings or not provided, the corresponding inputs will be left unchanged (empty) and the Search click will still execute (matching the original session flow).
- Export and mass-action steps only have effect if the relevant parameters are provided (export_format and massaction_option). If left empty, those steps still execute minimal interactions (select/click) but will not change UI state meaningfully.
- For environments that inject an admin secret-key into URLs, the recorded elementHashes and href-based XPath patterns still match because they search for substrings like '/sales_invoice/print/' or '/sales_invoice/view/invoice_id/'.
- This tool focuses exclusively on the core task: filter -> export -> mass-action -> view. It does not perform additional filtering/sorting beyond inputs supplied.
name: magento_admin_invoices_search_and_action
description: Navigate to Magento Admin Invoices grid, apply invoice filters, export results, perform a mass-action (e.g. PDF Invoices), and open the invoice View page. Uses recorded stable element hashes and XPath selectors captured during a recording on http://dockerized-magento.local. Authentication is assumed to already be handled by the session.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the Magento Admin Invoices grid start URL.
Input the Invoice # filter (visible increment id) into the Invoice # field recorded at elementHash 6d5a061d1b.
Input the Order # filter (visible increment id) into the Order # field recorded at elementHash ca9ff6c19c.
Input the Bill-to Name filter into the Bill-to field recorded at elementHash f395d4b12d.
Select the Invoice Status from the status dropdown recorded at elementHash 04857b749b. Use visible text such as 'Paid'.
Input Amount From (minimum total) into the Amount From field recorded at elementHash 6eece115d1.
Input Amount To (maximum total) into the Amount To field recorded at elementHash ab48eece81.
Click the Search button (Apply filters) recorded at elementHash 90708cd5ce to refresh the grid with provided filters.
Wait briefly for the grid to refresh after Search.
If {export_format} is provided, select that export format in the Export control recorded at elementHash e59543f7b4. (Possible values: CSV, Excel, XML.)
Click the Export button recorded at elementHash 3ec8757c2b to trigger export for the chosen format.
Wait for the export action to initiate (file download or server action).
Click the row checkbox to select the invoice row (recorded elementHash 59ef3d3b6c). This selects the visible invoice(s) for mass actions.
Choose the mass-action option from the Actions dropdown (recorded elementHash beeeaa3873). Use 'PDF Invoices' to generate PDFs.
Click the mass-action Submit button recorded at elementHash c7294e6557 to run the selected mass-action.
Wait for the mass-action to complete and server to respond.

Click the View link recorded at elementHash 0a5314fd88 to open the invoice View page. If the caller provided invoice_internal_id, prefer an href-based XPath matching '/admin/sales_invoice/view/invoice_id/{invoice_internal_id}/' (see tool_analysis notes).
After opening the invoice view, extract the key details and printable URL pattern for the invoice.
steps.goal: Capture invoice view summary: invoice increment id, internal invoice id (if present in URL), order link, customer link, and printable-invoice URL pattern

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Full URL of the Magento admin invoices grid start page (example: "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_invoice/")

input_schema.name: invoice_increment_id
input_schema.description: Visible invoice number (increment id) to filter by (e.g. "100000040"). Not the internal invoice_id.

input_schema.name: order_increment_id
input_schema.description: Visible order number (increment id) to filter by (e.g. "100000210").

input_schema.name: bill_to_name
input_schema.description: Bill-to name to filter by (e.g. "John Doe").

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Invoice status to filter by. Use 'Any' to leave status unchanged.

input_schema.name: amount_from
input_schema.description: Minimum total amount for invoice filter (numeric string, e.g. "0").

input_schema.name: amount_to
input_schema.description: Maximum total amount for invoice filter (numeric string, e.g. "1000").

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to use when clicking the Export control. Leave empty to skip export.

input_schema.name: massaction_option
input_schema.description: Mass action option to choose from the Actions dropdown. Use 'PDF Invoices' to generate PDFs. Leave empty to skip mass action.

input_schema.name: open_invoice_view
input_schema.description: If true, the tool will click the invoice 'View' link after mass action/export. If false or omitted, it will not open the invoice view.

input_schema.name: invoice_internal_id
input_schema.description: Internal invoice id (numeric) if known (used to prefer href-based View selector). If omitted the tool will click the View link captured during recording (elementHash).
